author: blu
body: Proves Fear: conditional evasion. A black 2/2 whose Oracle text is "can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures" compiles to FearAbility. It attacks into a white 3/3 that could block a normal creature; Fear forbids it, so the attacker connects for 2. A black 3/3 would be a legal blocker (fear-blocks is false for it). This separates Fear from the plain Unblockable (CL 6854): Fear is beatable by the right colour.
